p0.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi Krick Krock guides hold a straight edge level against the wall so you can set the first row of wall tiles off it, without screwing a batten into the wall. That matters over a waterproofing membrane you cannot drill or nail, and in a bathroom where the floor falls to a drain and you cannot work up from it. Set the two guides, lay the straight edge across, level it and tile.

Use it for

  • Setting the first row of wall tiles level in showers and bathrooms
  • Tiling over waterproofing membranes that cannot be penetrated
  • Starting a wall above a sloping or unfinished floor

Features

  • Adjustable height, extends up to 30 cm
  • Supports a standard straight edge or level
  • No fixings into the wall

Specifications

  • Supplied as a pair
  • Weight: about 700 g per pair
  • Model: 131
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Set the guide height so the straight edge sits one full tile plus a joint above the finished floor, so the bottom row can be cut in last.
  • Pair them with Raimondi's Kessler handles on the straight edge for screeding the floor afterwards.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi Speed stair setters hold a tread and riser in place while the adhesive cures. Hook one over each end of the step and it clamps the tread down and the riser back at the same time, so the pieces cannot slip while you move on to the next step. It replaces the bricks, wedges and tape tilers have always used to hold stairs, and gives a cleaner, faster result.

Use it for

  • Setting tiled and stone treads and risers on internal and external stairs
  • Holding a nosed tread tight to the riser while the adhesive sets

Features

  • Clamps tread and riser together in one action
  • Replaces bricks and weights
  • Reusable, step after step

Specifications

  • Tread thickness: 5 to 55 mm
  • Suits monolithic treads with at least 25 mm nosing projection
  • Supplied as a pair
  • Weight: about 1.5 kg per pair
  • Model: 171
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Leave the setters on until the adhesive has grabbed, then move them to the next step. Two pairs let you leapfrog up a staircase.
  • For gluing mitred tread and riser corners face up, Raimondi's Tip-Top clamps are the other stair tool.

p2.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Elia is a low dolly for your adhesive bucket and tiles. Put the bucket on it and the adhesive follows you across the floor on free spinning wheels instead of being carried, and with the cover on it carries a stack of tiles just as well. Take the cover off and the bucket sits tilted toward you, so you reach the last of the adhesive without bending into the bucket.

Use it for

  • Moving the adhesive bucket along with you as you lay a floor
  • Wheeling a stack of tiles or a grout bucket around the room
  • Tilting the bucket for easier access to the mix

Features

  • Low platform on free spinning wheels
  • Removable cover: on for a flat deck, off to tilt the bucket
  • Raimondi lists it as a bucket holder and tile dolly, Art. 384TRI

Good to know

  • Sized for a standard adhesive bucket. Raimondi's 27 and 45 litre buckets sit on it.
  • Keep the wheels clear of adhesive drips so they keep spinning freely.
  • For moving slabs rather than buckets, the Tyrrel cart is the heavier duty option.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi flexible knee pads have a ribbed, concertina style front that bends with your knee as you kneel, stand and shuffle along the floor. A rigid pad fights you every time you move; these flex with you, and the ribbing keeps the pad against your leg so sand and grit stay out, which is why Raimondi makes them for mud bed and screed work as well as tiling.

Use it for

  • Floor tiling, grouting and clean-up
  • Screeding and working on sand and cement beds
  • Any job where you are up and down off your knees all day

Features

  • Concertina style ribbed front that flexes with the knee
  • Replaceable soft foam inserts
  • Replaceable straps
  • Sold as a pair

Specifications

  • Model: 138SOFF (Raimondi knee pads with ribs)
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Spares are listed separately: rubber straps, elastic fabric straps with clips, and foam inserts, all in sets of 2.
  • Fit the strap so the pad sits just below the kneecap and stays put when you stand.
  • For a hard shell with gel padding see Raimondi's Relax knee pads; for a strap free option the Morbidone kneeling cushion.

p4.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Fido is a hand support you lean on while you work on the floor. Rest your free hand on it as you spread adhesive, place and adjust tiles and wash off, and it takes your body weight off your wrist, shoulder and back and lets you reach further across a large format tile without crawling onto it. Raimondi says it shortens laying times, and anyone with a sore wrist will believe it.

Use it for

  • Spreading adhesive over large areas, especially for large format tiles
  • Leaning out over a tile to place, adjust or clean it

Features

  • Ergonomic die cast aluminium body with rubber inserts
  • 4 removable white non slip, non marking rubber feet
  • Without the feet it sits on freshly spread adhesive without disturbing it; with the feet it rests on laid tiles

Specifications

  • Size: about 21.5 x 10.5 cm
  • Weight: about 540 g
  • Model: 174
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Clip the feet on before you lean on finished tiles so the aluminium cannot mark them.
  • Wipe adhesive off the base before it sets.

p5.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi Nelson is a rolling seat for tilers. Sit on it, rest a knee on the pad, and roll along the floor as you spread adhesive, lay tiles and grout, with your weight going through the seat instead of your knees and lower back. For anyone who does floors all week it is the difference between finishing the day sore and finishing it fine.

Use it for

  • Spreading adhesive and laying floor tiles
  • Grouting and clean-up on large floors
  • Any long stretch of kneeling or stooping work

Features

  • Strong, comfortable seat with knee pad
  • Rolls freely across the floor, and the wheels lock to make a stable low seat or step
  • Height adjusts from 25 to 35 cm

Specifications

  • Seat height: 25 to 35 cm
  • Model: 383COMBI (Raimondi rolling seat with knee pad)
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Set the height so your knee on the pad and your foot on the floor are both comfortable, then your back stays straight as you lean to the tile.
  • Keep the wheels clear of adhesive so they keep rolling.
  • Lock the wheels before you stand on it as a step.

p6.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi extending slab lifter is a two handled clamp for picking up and laying thick outdoor slabs and pavers. The jaws grip the edges of the slab, so you lift with your arms and set the piece down exactly where it goes without fingers underneath, and the extending bar adjusts to the slab width. Choose the 50 to 65 cm or 50 to 120 cm version to suit your slab size.

Use it for

  • Laying 20 mm porcelain pavers and concrete slabs
  • Lifting and placing textured outdoor slabs and stepping stones
  • Lifting a laid paver back out for adjustment

Features

  • Galvanised steel
  • Extending bar adjusts to the slab width
  • Two handles for a two person or two handed lift

Specifications

  • 50 to 65 cm: Raimondi Art. 144CM50-65, about 2 kg
  • 50 to 120 cm: Raimondi Art. 144CM50-120, about 4.4 kg
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • The jaws need a joint of at least 3 mm to grip a paver that is already laid.
  • For smaller pavers up to 50 cm, Raimondi's standard slab lifter is lighter.
  • Lift with a straight back and keep the slab close to your body.

p7.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi tile spacer crosses keep every grout joint the same width across a floor or wall. Drop one at each corner as you lay and the joints come out straight and even, which is what makes a grid of tiles look right. Raimondi makes them in 11 sizes from 1 to 10 mm, in bags of 200 or 1000, with special shapes for hexagonal tiles and shielded and arrow types.

Use it for

  • Setting consistent grout joints on floor and wall tiles
  • Cross (grid) and T (brick bond) layouts
  • Hexagonal tiles with the 3 mm hex spacer

Specifications

  • Joint widths: 1 to 10 mm
  • Pack sizes: 200 or 1000
  • 3 mm spacer for hexagonal tiles (Raimondi Art. 161E200, 200 per bag)
  • Shielded and arrow type 3 mm spacers
  • Made in Italy

Good to know

  • Raimondi's range runs to 43 models, including versions with holes for adhesive to pass through and fins for easy removal from a mud bed.
  • Pull the spacers before you grout, or lay them flat under the joint if the joint is deep enough to cover them.
  • For large format tiles and lippage control, step up to the Raimondi R.L.S. levelling system.
